title: RFD2-MI designs sequence-specific cysteine proteases
summary: RFD2-MI designs cysteine-nucleophile proteases that cleave peptide backbones in a sequence-dependent manner. The preprint abstract reports rate enhancements up to 3 × 10^7 and crystal structures close to design models. The journal version reports additional experiments; this entry covers only the preprint abstract result and does not carry later results across versions.
organization: Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington

evidence.tested: The source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broader deployment or clinical benefit are not established by this source review.
evidence.ai_role: RFD2-MI generates catalytic protein structures; sequence design and structure prediction support experimental selection.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary preprint abstract and metadata; journal publisher endpoint was inaccessible
